note: Harrison County IA (19085) publishes zoning only as ordinance text and PDF maps. Its GIS page lists zoning but links no queryable zoning service; the county's ArcGIS Online org (HarrCo, services1.arcgis.com/fr2AOkFeMwixG9dx) holds parcel, park and Applefest layers, no zoning. Missouri Valley's zoning is a PDF map. The only queryable district layer is an ISU compiled copy (services.arcgis.com/XORNS2fPFySPlBgy, zoning_districts_all_data_v2) covering only Logan and Missouri Valley; it fails validation with 6 to 12 of 9 to 15 polygons invalid, so it was not submitted.
